forbidden_diff_signatures.description: any path outside targets.json's assigned class globs
a rename whose source OR destination is a forbidden path or falls outside the assigned class
a new or modified symlink entry inside an allowed-class glob resolving outside that class
a decrease in def test_ count, or a new skip/xfail marker, on any touched test_*.py file

a byte-level change to a ## Why or ## How sub-section inside a PROSE:BEGIN/PROSE:END block whose OLD content was not byte-equal to that row's pristine UNFILLED marker (docs_stub_generate.py:65,332-351,479-481; an unparseable PROSE block falls back to the strict whole-block rule)

a changed path (including a rename's source/destination and a symlink's own path/resolved target), after NFKC normalization, contains a '..' segment, a backslash, a control character, leading/trailing whitespace in a segment, mixed scripts within a segment, or, under .claude/**, a non-printable-ASCII character; kept as a ninth entry rather than folded under forbidden-path-touch because it is a distinct mechanism (Unicode/traversal hygiene, checked before any glob decision) from literal membership in the forbidden_paths list

work_dir_file_count_rule: the round must not leave Projects/*/work/ with more files than it found, unless the new file matches the PR body's own deliverable_path field
